supersedes.reason: independent audit of release-v1 (evidence/release-designs-t076-2026-09-25.md): B1-B4 blocking, S1-S8 should-fix; release-v1 is kept unchanged

purpose: The release qualification design for the Q01-family critic configuration: a scoped acceptance rule for one exact configuration on one sealed set, frozen before any heldout material exists. It is not a general capability claim and cannot by itself satisfy the error-independence requirement (V3).
execution_state: kept outside this pinned file (a separate run record); this file never changes in place

configuration_under_test.binding: All identity fields are fixed in the run record before the first dispatch; a change to any is a new configuration, and the sealed set it ran on is spent (see dataset.single_use).
configuration_under_test.lens_arm: The qualified configuration names its lens set explicitly (possibly empty); a qualification never carries over between a lens and a no-lens configuration.

dataset.must_be_new: No case, material, candidate, counterexample or wording from evals/deeptwin/q01_materials.py, q01_lenses.json or the ten calibration cases, and no paraphrase of them.

authoring.author: A named person who has not seen the verifier's calibration expectations and does not tune the critic configuration.
excluded_as_author_reviewer_or_judge: the developer who built the Q01 harness and verifier
anyone who tuned the critic configuration
any model or session with repository access, and any model of the critic's family
authoring.expectations: Written by the author from the new materials alone, before any trial, and sealed (content sha256 recorded in the run record).
authoring.review: A second named person, not the author and not the judge, checks each expectation against the materials before sealing; a disagreement is resolved or the case dropped, never averaged.

required_coverage: at least one required_defect for each of Q1 (meaning), Q2 (hand-off), Q3 (authority)
at least one valid alternative (Q4) inside accept_without_false_rejection
every valid_counterexample paired: the same counterexample applied to a candidate that forces the defect and one that preserves or corrects it (Q5)
composition.note: A scoped design choice so every class and criterion has instances; it is not a statistical sample size and supports no rate estimate.

storage_and_access.location: outside the git repository, in an owner-controlled location recorded by path and sha256 in the run record
storage_and_access.during_run: agent inputs come only from the harness's allowlisted reader; expectations are read only by the verifier; every read is logged in the run record
storage_and_access.results: the developer reads trial outputs and verdicts only after the suite verdict is recorded
storage_and_access.single_use: The first dispatched trial marks the set observed. Exactly one run per sealed set: no continuation, merge or rerun. A fail or incomplete result closes this design on this set; a new attempt needs a new sealed set (and, after any configuration change, a new design version).

execution.repetition_meaning: three calls on one case are one task sample, never three independent samples
execution.output_contract_error: a completed trial whose output breaks the contract is a fail of that repetition (Task.md), never an invalid trial
execution.invalid_trials: only harness, evidence, isolation or judge failures; reported with cause, never scored, never replaced within the run
execution.authority: The run record names who authorized the run, the authority reference and the budget; without it the run is not executed and that is stated.
execution.spend: a hard USD stop fixed in the run record before any call; a stopped run is incomplete

judge.judge_errors: every judge verdict is recorded beside the sealed expectation; a judge failure makes that trial invalid (Task.md Q8); judge-versus-expectation disagreements are listed, never folded into the critic's score

acceptance.case_pass: a case passes only if every one of its repetitions is valid and passes under the frozen verifier
acceptance.incomplete: any case with fewer valid repetitions than planned makes the suite incomplete (no verdict), never a pass
acceptance.judge_dependence: semantic items count only under an independence profile version whose judge_separation.established is true; otherwise they are not_judged and the suite cannot pass

reporting: per case and boundary class: passes, misses (a required defect not found), false rejections (a valid candidate or alternative rejected), abstentions, and not_judged items, each with its real denominator
same-item joint errors of critic and judge
cluster counts (cases sharing materials count as one cluster)
every invalid trial with its cause, calls, tokens, spend and wall time
claims_if_passed: This exact configuration met the frozen acceptance rule on this sealed set, in these repetitions.
V3 (error independence) remains unmet: this design fixes no joint-error criteria, so no automatic critic qualification follows from a pass.
never_claimed: an error rate, false-rejection rate or missed-defect rate beyond the observed counts
generalization to other tasks or materials
